```yaml
name: Update compat-table

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Monday 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          all_but_latest: true
          ignore_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Get latest compat-table SHA
        id: latest_sha
        run: |
          echo "Fetching latest commit SHA from compat-table/compat-table"
          LATEST_SHA=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits?per_page=1 | \
            jq -r '.[0].sha')
          echo "latest_sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Read current compat-table SHA
        id: current_sha
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies["compat-table"]' tasks/compat_data/package.json)
          echo "current_sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}" = "${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.current_sha }}" ]; then
            echo "No update needed"
            echo "needs_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Update needed"
            echo "needs_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update package.json and rebuild
        if: steps.compare.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          NEW_SHA=${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}
          # Update the dependency in package.json
          jq --arg sha "$NEW_SHA" '.dependencies["compat-table"] = $sha' tasks/compat_data/package.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json tasks/compat_data/package.json
          # Run init and build
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build
          # Stage changes
          git add tasks/compat_data/package.json
          git add tasks/compat_data/*
          # Commit
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "chore: update compat-table to $NEW_SHA" || echo "No changes to commit"
          # Push to a unique branch
          BRANCH="update-compat-table-${{ github.run_id }}"
          git push origin HEAD:$BRANCH

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.compare.outputs.needs_update == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const branch = 'update-compat-table-${{ github.run_id }}';
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: 'chore: update compat-table to latest commit',
              head: branch,
              base: 'main',
              body: `Updated compat-table from ${{ steps.current_sha.outputs.current_sha }} to ${{ steps.latest_sha.outputs.latest_sha }}.\n\nThis update ensures the latest compatibility data is used.`,
              assignees: ['Boshen']
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
```
